title: Design System: Jairus OS — NERV/MAGI Tactical Console

display.purpose: Page/hero headlines and giant numerals. ALL CAPS, glowing.

headline.purpose: Card and section titles, primary objectives.

jp-display.purpose: Large kanji graphic in headers, alerts, mastheads. Always paired with an English caption.

body.purpose: Monospace UI text, KEY:VALUE metadata, terminal rows.

label.purpose: Field labels, captions, legend text, eyebrows. Wide tracking, ALL CAPS.

shadows.name: text-glow
shadows.purpose: Luminance halo on headlines, active stamps, alarm text. Intensity graded red > orange > green. Not a drop shadow.

shadows.name: box-glow-orange
shadows.purpose: The 'elevation' of a chrome panel/frame — an emitted halo, never a cast shadow.

shadows.name: focus-glow-mint
shadows.purpose: Focused input ring; replaces the browser default outline.

shadows.name: seg-glow-mint
shadows.purpose: Per-lit LED segment glow in meters and gauges (swap hue per zone).

motion.name: blink
motion.purpose: In-progress signal on stamps, cursors, pending nodes. Urgent variant: .5s.

motion.name: btnblink
motion.purpose: Selected/primary-action button — the live action pulses between filled and outlined.

motion.name: step-fill
motion.purpose: Meter/gauge fills advance one discrete LED segment at a time, 8–15/sec. Never a tweened width.

motion.name: teletype
motion.purpose: Terminal and receipt rows enter in whole-row chunks, mechanically.

motion.name: state-snap
motion.purpose: State changes are instant; an optional 2–3 frame hide/show flicker precedes the settle. Never a fade.

motion.name: teardown
motion.purpose: Loaders/progress end by extinguishing segments in reverse, not by fading opacity.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Kill blinks/strobe/marquee/flicker; render the final settled state.

components.name: Primary Button (blinking selected)
components.description: Primary action. Outlined at rest; the selected/live state inverts to a solid mint fill with black text and blinks to signal 'this is the action to take.'
components.css: .ds-btn-primary{font-family:'Arial Narrow','Avenir Next Condensed','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:10px 20px;border:2px solid #52F29A;color:#52F29A;background:#0A0A0A;cursor:pointer;border-radius:0;animation:ds-btnblink 1s steps(1) infinite}.ds-btn-primary:hover{background:#52F29A;color:#0A0A0A;box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(82,242,154,.4)}.ds-btn-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #EDF8D6;outline-offset:3px}@keyframes ds-btnblink{0%,74%{background:#52F29A;color:#0A0A0A}75%,100%{background:#0A0A0A;color:#52F29A}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-btn-primary{animation:none;background:#52F29A;color:#0A0A0A}}

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary/quiet action. Muted green-dim outline in the mono face.

components.name: Status Stamp
components.description: Boxed status word. Outline = record, .blink = in-progress, .fill = active (inverse). Colorway via currentColor — set color to switch state hue.
components.html: NOMINAL 審査中 OFFLINE

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Tactical text field. Void bg, dim-green idle border, mint text/caret, uppercase; focus swaps the border to mint with a glow ring instead of a browser outline.

components.name: Panel / Card
components.description: Base surface. Void fill, 1–2px orange border, faint inset orange glow. Never elevated with a drop shadow. Titled with a zone-title.

components.name: Segmented Meter + Threshold
components.description: Discrete LED-segment gauge (never a continuous fill), colored per zone, with a drawn labeled threshold rule riding across.
components.html: LIMIT · 70

narrative.overview: Everything luminous blooms on true black. This is not a dark theme — it is a CRT command deck. Information is drawn in glowing phosphor mint, cut with safety orange chrome and blood-red alarms. There is no elevation, no soft depth, no glass. Hierarchy is built from three materials only: border, glow, and hue. A panel is a stroked box on black; an active control is a solid block of color with the black content punched out of it. Motion is mechanical throughout — stepped segment fills, hard 1–2 Hz blinks, teletype rows, snap state changes. Nothing eases, nothing fades. The screens feel hand-cranked, like a machine reporting rather than an app animating. It rejects elevation surfaces, eased/spring motion, glass panels, humanist body type, and calm neutral palettes: familiarity is not the goal, a committed and internally-consistent tactical identity is.
keyCharacteristics: True near-black (#0A0A0A) is the only surface; hierarchy from border + glow + hue, never elevation.
Color is state: mint nominal, orange chrome, blue pending, amber caution, red critical.
Figure/ground inversion marks activation — idle outline on black, active solid fill with black content.
Bimodal type: one giant element plus tiny dense captions; nothing mid-sized.
Bilingual by default: Mincho kanji graphic + small Latin caption.
Mechanical motion only: steps() and setInterval ticks, never eased curves.
A CRT scanline + vignette pass overlays every dark screen.

rules.name: The Orange-Is-Chrome Rule
rules.body: Safety Orange (#F26400) draws the machine and never carries meaning. Borders, rules, dividers, axes, section numbers, metadata keys — orange. A data value, a status, or a result is never orange. If orange is saying something, it's wrong.

rules.name: The Color-Is-State Rule
rules.body: A component's hue is its status, not its brand. The same panel renders mint/amber/blue/red to mean nominal/caution/pending/critical without moving a pixel. Parameterize by currentColor.

rules.name: The No-Lowercase Rule
rules.body: UI chrome is ALL CAPS — labels, buttons, headers, data, terminal. Lowercase only in genuine reading prose. A lowercase button or status is wrong.

rules.name: The Bimodal-Scale Rule
rules.body: Cluster type at the two ends: tiny (8–14px) and large (22px–hero). Mid-sized type reads generic. One giant element per screen, everything else small.

rules.name: The Bilingual-Pairing Rule
rules.body: A large Mincho kanji never appears alone in functional UI. It is the graphic; a small Latin caption beneath is the translation. Untranslated decorative kanji is forbidden.

rules.name: The No-Elevation Rule
rules.body: Prohibited: box-shadow as a drop shadow, lighter-gray raised surfaces, backdrop-filter glass. Depth is border + glow + hue. A surface lifted by a soft gray shadow gets a border instead.

rules.name: The Glow-On-Black-Only Rule
rules.body: Glow renders on luminous elements against #0A0A0A. Content punched out of a filled control (black on mint) gets no glow — the fill carries the light, the content stays crisp.

dos: Do keep #0A0A0A as the only background and build hierarchy from border + glow + hue.
Do make color mean state — mint nominal, blue pending, amber caution, red critical — and parameterize by currentColor.
Do render active/selected states as figure/ground inversion: solid hue fill, black content, no glow on the content.
Do box every status word in a stamp; blink = in-progress, solid fill = recorded/active.
Do pair every large kanji with a small English caption.
Do keep motion mechanical — steps() and setInterval ticks, 150–250ms or stepped, with a prefers-reduced-motion alternative that renders the final state.
Do reserve Safety Orange (#F26400) for chrome only.
Do overlay the CRT scanline + vignette pass on every dark screen.
Do number a sequence only when it is one (form sections, the OODA loop, an ingestion pipeline).
donts: Don't use elevation for depth: no drop shadows, no lighter-gray raised surfaces, no glassmorphism / backdrop-filter panels.
Don't ease or spring anything — no cubic-bezier state transitions, no opacity fades for state, no bounce. Linear or steps() only.
Don't use border-left/right > 1px as a colored accent stripe. Use a full border, a background tint, or a leading stamp.
Don't use background-clip:text gradient text. Emphasis via weight, size, and glow on a single solid color.
Don't write UI chrome in lowercase or set labels/buttons/data in the Mincho display font.
Don't let Safety Orange carry a data value or a status.
Don't put glow on black-on-fill content.
Don't reach for a modal by default; when a modal is right, keep it to one focal job.
Don't ship a light warm-neutral variant as the default; the system is dark-only.
